assignments.name: verdict
assignments.value: Use it if you run a small game studio, a modding channel or sell showcase videos. Everyone else: do not install it, steal the idea (written skills plus a notes folder your agent reads first and writes last).

assignments.name: cost
assignments.value: Kit free (MIT). You pay for your AI agent plan and per-generation fal art/3D/audio. Single-player games you own only.

assignments.name: install
assignments.value: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add rehan-remade/universal-modder, then /plugin install universal-modder@universal-modder
